items.text: In adults having low-risk ambulatory or elective surgery, which strategies (system changes, feedback on own ordering, pre-anaesthesia clinic triage, clinician education, patient materials), alone or combined, reduce low-value preoperative testing compared with usual practice, how durable are the reductions, and do same-day cancellations or perioperative complications change?
items.population: Adults having low-risk ambulatory or elective surgery
items.intervention: Strategies to reduce low-value preoperative testing, alone or combined
items.comparator: Usual practice or the period before the strategy
items.outcome: Proportion of patients with at least one low-value test; durability; same-day cancellations; perioperative complications

finer: Feasible in ten weeks with a librarian and two analysts using rapid methods; interesting to the committee; novel as a strategy-by-strategy synthesis with balancing outcomes; ethical (published literature); relevant because the guidance revision depends on it.
summary: One PICO question covering strategies, durability and balancing outcomes.
